title: Paystride Save Account Status Standards: Verification, Freezes, Closure and Settings
content:
A Paystride Save account is always in one of four statuses: pending, open, frozen or closed. These standards govern how it moves between them and what the worker may change along the way.

## Standards

**S1 — Verification.** The bank opens a pending account when identity verification completes, and a pending account lapses after the pending-verification period, in calendar days.

**S2 — Freeze.** The desk freezes an open account on suspected fraud or a legal order and reviews it within the freeze-review period, in business days.

**S3 — Lifting a freeze.** The desk lifts a freeze only on an account whose status is frozen.

**S4 — Closure.** Closing is the worker's own decision, registered as a request and confirmed by the worker: A worker-confirmed closure applies only to an account whose status is open. The balance is paid out to the linked card within the closing-payout period, in business days.

**S5 — Card closure.** When the linked card account closes, the savings account is closed with it under the same rules because an active Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account is required for Paystride Save.

**S6 — Settings.** The worker may change the round-up multiplier up to the tier's highest round-up multiplier, the auto-save percentage up to the tier's highest share of a payroll load, and a goal up to the tier's largest savings goal at any time while the account is not closed.

## Status moves

| From | To | Brought about by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| pending | open | the bank, when identity verification completes | S1 |
| pending | closed | lapse of the application unverified | S1 |
| open | frozen | the desk, on suspected fraud or a legal order | S2 |
| frozen | open | the desk, lifting the freeze after review | S3 |
| open | closed | the worker's confirmed closure | S4 |

## Reading the standards

- **Lifting a freeze** requires the account's recorded status to be frozen; an account in any other status has no freeze to lift.
- **A worker-confirmed closure** requires the account's recorded status to be open. A frozen account is not open, so a closure does not apply to it while it is frozen; a pending account is not open either.
- **Settings** may be changed in pending, open or frozen status, and not once the account is closed. A multiplier of zero means round-ups are off, a percentage of zero means auto-save is off, and a goal of $0.00 means no goal.
- **Card closure** closes the savings account with the card account under the same rules as any closure, including the payout of the balance to the linked card.

### Hypothetical cases

| Recorded status | Request | Outcome under the standards |
|---|---|---|
| frozen | lift the freeze | within S3 |
| open | lift a freeze | outside S3: the status is not frozen |
| open | worker-confirmed closure | within S4 |
| frozen | worker-confirmed closure | outside S4: the status is not open |
| frozen | raise the auto-save percentage within the tier ceiling | within S6: the account is not closed |
